shipping: Build an app that picks a shipping tier from a parcel's weight in kilograms and its destination: domestic, Europe or worldwide.
thermostat: Build a thermostat app that decides whether to heat, cool or stay idle from the indoor temperature and the outdoor temperature in degrees Celsius.
loan: Build an app that approves, refers or declines a loan from the applicant's credit score, yearly income and the amount requested.
parking: Build an app that tells the parking fee band from the hours parked and whether it is a weekday or a weekend.
ticket: Build an app that tells whether a visitor pays the child, adult or senior ticket price from their age.
payment: Build an app that decides whether a payment is approved from the role of the person (clerk or manager), the amount and their limit.
grade: Build an app that turns an exam score from 0 to 100 into a letter grade from a to f.
delivery: Build an app that decides whether an order ships free from the order total in dollars and whether the customer is a member.
triage: Build an app that sorts a patient into urgent, soon or routine from a pain level of 0 to 10 and whether they have a fever.
door: Build an app that decides whether a door opens from the person's role (guest, staff or admin) and the area (lobby, office or vault).
overtime: Build an app that says whether a shift counts as regular, overtime or double time from the hours worked that day and whether it is a holiday.
refund: Build an app that decides whether a return gets a full refund, store credit or nothing from the days since purchase and whether the item was opened.
budget: Build an app that says whether a purchase is within budget from its price and the money left in the budget.
bmi: Build an app that labels a body mass index as underweight, normal, overweight or obese.
speeding: Build an app that decides between no action, a warning, a fine or a court summons from a driver's speed and the speed limit.
stock: Build an app that tells a shop whether to reorder, hold or mark down an item from the units in stock and the units sold last week.
voting: Build an app that tells whether someone may vote from their age and whether they are a citizen.
luggage: Build an app that decides whether a bag flies as carry-on, checked or oversize from its weight in kilograms and its longest side in centimetres.
discount: Build an app that picks no discount, a small one or a large one from the number of items in the basket and the customer tier: new, regular or gold.
water: Build an app that tells a gardener to water, wait or skip from the soil moisture percentage and whether rain is forecast.
password: Build an app that rates a password as weak, fair or strong from its length and whether it has a digit and whether it has a symbol.
tip: Build an app that suggests a low, standard or generous tip from the service rating of 1 to 5 and the party size.
leave: Build an app that approves or refuses a leave request from the days requested, the days remaining and whether the team is short-staffed.
toll: Build an app that picks the toll class from the number of axles and whether the vehicle is electric.
library: Build an app that decides whether a library book may be renewed from the times it was already renewed and whether someone else has reserved it.
battery: Build an app that tells a phone to run normally, save power or shut down from the battery percentage and whether it is charging.
rent: Build an app that decides whether a tenant application is accepted, needs a guarantor or is refused from monthly income and monthly rent.
fever: Build an app that says whether a child stays home, sees a doctor or goes to school from the body temperature in tenths of a degree Celsius and the child's age in months.
queue: Build an app that routes a support ticket to the bot, an agent or a manager from its priority (low, normal or high) and the customer plan: free, pro or enterprise.
elevator: Build an app that says whether a lift may move from the load in kilograms, its capacity in kilograms and whether the doors are closed.
visa: Build an app that says whether a traveller needs no visa, a visa on arrival or a visa in advance from the length of stay in days and the purpose: tourism, business or study.
irrigation: Build an app that sets a pump to off, low or high from the tank level percentage and the time of day: morning, afternoon or night.
credit: Build an app that sets a card limit to basic, standard or premium from the customer's credit score and the years they have been a customer.
exam: Build an app that says whether a student passes, resits or fails from the exam mark out of 100 and the coursework mark out of 100.
bike: Build an app that says whether a rented bike is returned on time, late or very late from the minutes used and the minutes paid for.
alarm: Build an app that decides whether a house alarm stays quiet, chirps or sounds from the mode (home, away or night) and whether a door sensor is open.
cart: Build an app that tells whether a checkout may proceed from the number of items, the stock available and whether the customer is signed in.
fuel: Build an app that warns a driver with ok, low or critical from the litres of fuel left and the kilometres to the next station.
seat: Build an app that assigns economy, premium or business from the fare paid in dollars and the loyalty status: none, silver or gold.
moderation: Build an app that decides whether a post is published, held for review or removed from the number of reports and whether the author is verified.
